title: Couple
spaceIntro: Only after an invitation and both people agree. A mutual match does not create a shared space.
setStartDateCta: Add your start date under Us
emptyPremiumTitle: A private space for the two of you
emptyPremiumBody: Memories, map, and plans open only after an invite and mutual consent. A mutual like does not create Couple Space.
noLatestBody: Add your first memory to show it here.
plansIntro: Upcoming dates and things you want to do together.
proposeDateHint: Status becomes confirmed only when both of you confirm. We do not book venues for you.
usSettingsHint: Display name, start date, and a short line on the cover. Full cover upload uses private pair media when available.
spaceTitlePh: Leave blank to use both names
coverHint: Cover uses your private couple media. Update the space name and start date below.
inviteIntro: Invite by email or a one-time code. The recipient signs up or logs in, then opens the link to pair. A mutual like does not create Couple Space.
createFailed: Could not create an invite code.
acceptedSpace: Couple space created. A mutual like does not create a shared space.
inviteSent: Invitation sent. Shared space is created when the other person accepts.
inviteByEmailHint: They get a link — sign up or log in, then join Couple Space directly.
emailSent: Invite email sent. They open the link to accept.
emailStubSent: Invite created. Real email is not configured yet — copy the link below.
emailSendFailed: Invite created but email failed — copy the link manually.
joinGuestIntro: Create an account or log in to accept the invitation and open your private shared space.
joinLoginHint: After you log in, you’ll continue to the Couple invitation.
joinSignupHint: After you create an account, you’ll accept the Couple invitation right away.
joinMissingHint: Open the link from the email again, or ask for a new invitation.
disconnectConfirm: Disconnecting closes this shared space. Shared data is handled per our published policy. You cannot undo this alone.
emptySpaceBody: Create or accept a dedicated invitation before using the map and memories.
emptyPinsBody: Create your first pin on the memory map.
commerceBridgeBody: From moments to gift ideas / date plans — optional, fees shown before you confirm. Private journals stay out unless you opt in.
usEmptyBody: Create or accept a dedicated invitation. A mutual match only opens chat.
exportHint: Shared pins only — private journals are excluded.
disconnectHint: After disconnecting, couple data does not carry into a new space.
disconnectModalBody: This ends the current shared space. Are you sure?
usPageIntro: Manage the connection. Either person can disconnect without the other’s consent. A new space does not carry prior history.
mapIntro: Mapbox. Pick a location manually if GPS is declined. No background tracking. Three layers: visited · wishlist · milestone.
addEmptyBody: An invitation and mutual consent are required before creating pins.
pinJournalPartial: Pin created; private note not saved (check journal permissions).
mapLoadPinsError: Could not load pins (an active couple is required).
mapEmptySpaceBody: An invitation and mutual consent are required before using the memory map.
mapOsmHint: Free OSM map (no background GPS). Mapbox is optional when a token is set.
pinsEmptyBody: Pins belong only to an activated couple space; personal notes are private by default.
pinsFilterEmptyBody: Change the filter or add a new pin.
osmInitError: Could not initialize the OSM map.
osmEmptyPins: No pins with coordinates yet. Use “Find coordinates” from a place name or enter lat/lng manually.
mapboxEmptyPins: No pins with coordinates yet — add lat/lng when creating a pin to show the Mapbox canvas. The list below still works.
addPageIntro: Saved on the three-layer map. Private reflections (journal) are visible only to you by default.
promisesIntro: Places on the “Want to visit” layer. Convert them to memories after you go.
promisesEmptyBody: Add places you want to visit together on the wishlist layer.
memoriesIntro: Timeline of pins saved in your couple space.
